subject.title: refactor: remove expired plugin compatibility surfaces

question: Should the July 21, 2026 release remove plugin compatibility surfaces whose published removeAfter dates fall between July 22 and July 30, 2026?
rationale: The PR explicitly targets records through July 30 while its stated planned release predates those dates; this changes a published external-plugin contract and cannot be resolved safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Honor published dates
options.body: Keep each compatibility surface through its recorded removeAfter date and land the corresponding removal only in a release after that date.

options.title: Supersede the schedule explicitly
options.body: Approve an earlier removal only with an explicit maintainer decision, updated release communication, and an upgrade path for affected external plugins.

recommendation.title: Honor published dates
recommendation.body: Keep each compatibility surface through its recorded removeAfter date and land the corresponding removal only in a release after that date.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch and PR body identify this as the maintainer-approved compatibility-removal sweep, and steipete authored the relevant commits.
